newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends firm on cenbnk dlr sales.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends firm on cenbnk dlr sales.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed firmer at 484.25/485.25 per dollar on Central Bank dollar sales, traders said.
The bolivar closed Monday at 484.50/485.50 per dollar.
"Although there was little demand (for dollars), the Central bank was selling them throughout the day -- especially in the afternoon, and that firmed the exchange rate," one trader said.

Venezuela's foreign exchange market is unusual in that the Central Bank is its largest single supplier of dollars, which blurs the difference between the Central Bank supplying liquidity and intervening.
Other traders said the exchange rate had also been firmed on dollar sales by private corporate clients and brokerages.
